description: Current list price of one SKU (id like vps/ovhcloud/vps-2027-model2 or llm/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5) with all secondary prices, USD/EUR equivalents, spec, source URL, verified_at, a stale flag that is true when the source's latest fetch failed (the price shown is then the last verified one), and other listings of the same model. Returns an error object for an unknown id.

sku_id.description: SKU id as returned by search_skus, e.g. vps/vultr/vc2-1c-1gb
sku_id.title: Sku Id
